description: Apple, Samsung, Oppo, Vivo, and Google offer smartphones with the best video recording capabilities under Rs. 1,00,000 in India. The iPhone 17 was launched in India and other global markets in September last year. The price of the handset was recently raised in the country. The iPhone 17 is capable of recording 4K resolution videos at up to 60 fps. Meanwhile, the Samsung Galaxy S26 and Vivo X300 FE support up to 8K video recording.
title: Best Phones for Video Recording in India Under Rs. 1 Lakh: From iPhone 17 to Google Pixel 11 and More

description: If you suspect that your Facebook account has been hacked, the first step is to visit facebook.com/hacked. Facebook recommends using a phone or computer, or another device that you have previously used to log in to your account. If you regain access, you can reset your password. Here's a step-by-step guide to recover your hacked Facebook account.
title: How to Recover a Hacked Facebook Account: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Brands are increasingly adding high-resolution front cameras, autofocus, improved portrait processing, and AI-backed imaging tools. This has made the selfie camera an important factor when considering a new smartphone purchase. Flagship models from Vivo, Samsung, Google, and others offer advanced camera systems. Meanwhile, you can find 50-megapixel selfie shooters in models in the upper-mid-range and the mid-range segments, too. So if buying a new smartphone with a stellar selfie camera is on your list, then we’ve got your back.
title: Best Selfie Camera Smartphones in India: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL, Vivo V70 FE, Nothing Phone 3a Pro and More

description: Google allows users to enable two-factor authentication for their accounts to add an extra layer of protection against hackers. Even if the password to your Google account gets compromised, leaked, or stolen, the bad actors will not be able to gain unauthorised access to your account without getting through the second verification step. This makes it harder for your Google account to get hacked. Since your Google account stores crucial information and personal data, like your name, address, and financial information, two-factor authentication can protect this data from getting stolen.
title: How to Turn On Two-Factor Authentication for Google Account: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Temporary files can build up on a Windows 11 PC and gradually take up valuable storage space. You can clear them using Windows' Settings app, the Disk Cleanup tool or the Temp folder. Each method gives you a different way to review and remove data that you no longer need. However, some categories require more care, particularly files from previous Windows installations. This guide explains where to find temporary files, how to remove them safely and when it makes sense to clear them.
title: How to Clear Temporary Files in Windows 11: A Step-by-Step Guide
